title: DISCH II: discharge profiles in the §8.4 form, Pareto search, bounded dominance and classification (test milestone T32: the delay guard on M1's machine; M3: the classification of I31's basis)

predictions.claim: The pay point (1, 0) of the delay guard (T32, the agent submitter 2 at s*) in the §8.4 form, ∃ strategy table ∀ schedule of at most H = 2 moves over the challenger (4) and anyone (5) at the turns' block time, is PROVED: L_dp_delay_point_1_0, its table surviving every schedule over the E-closure alphabet (the instrument replays every schedule).
The wait point (0, 19) in the same form, H and principals, is PROVED: L_dp_delay_point_0_19, its table surviving every schedule.

The bounded dominance law L_dp_delay_dominance is PROVED: every strategy of at most 4 moves from s* ending in a successful commitBatch by the agent has cost >= 1 or delay >= 19; the instrument's exhaustive enumeration finds no outcome with cost < 1 and delay < 19.

The persistent profile (Def 6.20's text: kappa false after the target move) is {(0, 19)}, class delay, and its law L_dp_delay_persistent_0_19 is PROVED; the one-occurrence class is mixed, and every T32 record carries disch_class mixed. BUILD_PLAN's I32 row expected {(c_msg per trigger, 0), (0, Δ_fin per trigger)}, class mixed, counting each batch as a trigger; this key predicts from Def 6.20's text, under which paying never falsifies kappa.

The time abstraction is sound at s* within 60 s: L_dp_delay_abstraction is PROVED, and for every dt in 0..60 each alphabet move's outcome after a wait of dt equals its outcome after the wait to the greatest hinted deadline <= dt.

regressions.claim: The one-occurrence frontier at s* within 4 moves is {(1, 0), (0, 19)}, and (1000, 0) (commitBatchWithProof) is an outcome dominated by (1, 0), as docs/M1_REPORT.md §2.1 and laws/M1/L_disch_delay_prove.json record.

No file of the holon-ir/0.1-0.3 closures or of the typed, DISCH, UNDO and FACT runners changes; no M0-M3 law, record or Bend file changes except gen/M3/disch/classification.json; M1's L_disch_delay_* records are unchanged.
